cues.en: Instructor: Now I'm going to show you how to create violin plots in code.
cues.zh: 講師：現在我要示範如何用程式繪製小提琴圖。

cues.en: Now it turns out that MATLAB doesn't have a function built-in to produce violin plots given a dataset.
cues.zh: MATLAB 並沒有內建函式，能直接根據資料集繪製小提琴圖。

cues.en: If you look online, you will find MATLAB functions for violin plots.
cues.zh: 如果上網搜尋，你會找到繪製小提琴圖的 MATLAB 函式。

cues.en: Those are all user submitted functions.
cues.zh: 那些都是使用者提交的函式。

cues.en: So it's just functions that people wrote and it's not necessarily supported by MathWorks, the company that produces MATLAB.
cues.zh: 也就是其他人自行撰寫的函式，不一定受到 MATLAB 開發公司 MathWorks 的支援。

cues.en: So I encourage you if you like to go online and find some file that you find useful and that makes a nice plot and you can use that in the future.
cues.zh: 因此，如果你有興趣，我鼓勵你上網找找實用、能畫出漂亮圖形的檔案，之後就可以使用。

cues.en: But here I'm gonna show you that it's actually relatively easy to create your own code to produce a violin plot in MATLAB.
cues.zh: 不過，這裡我要示範，其實自己撰寫 MATLAB 程式來產生小提琴圖相對容易。

cues.en: So let's get started.
cues.zh: 我們開始吧。

cues.en: We are going to create some data.
cues.zh: 先建立一些資料。

cues.en: Here I'm setting the data to be a log normal distribution.
cues.zh: 這裡我把資料設定為對數常態分布。

cues.en: So we have random numbers drawn from a normal distribution, a gaussian distribution, pass those through a natural exponential.
cues.zh: 先從常態分布，也就是高斯分布，抽取隨機數，再將這些數值送入自然指數函數。

cues.en: Now this function here is basically just something I'm doing because I want to have some extra features on the violin plot.
cues.zh: 這裡這段操作，主要是因為我想讓小提琴圖多一些特徵。

cues.en: I want that extra little clustering of data towards the top that I showed in the previous slide or in the previous video.
cues.zh: 我想讓上方多一小群聚集的資料，就像前一張投影片，或前一部影片中展示的那樣。

cues.en: So what I do is define a threshold here and I say that the data that exceeds, so all the data points that exceed that threshold, I'm gonna set them to be
cues.zh: 所以我在這裡定義一個門檻，然後把超過門檻的資料，也就是所有超過該門檻的資料點，設定為

cues.en: that threshold plus just a bunch of scaled down random numbers.
cues.zh: 門檻值加上一批經過縮小的隨機數。

cues.en: So there's nothing particularly magic or you know, meaningful about the way that I'm doing this.
cues.zh: 這個做法沒有什麼特別神奇或有意義的地方。

cues.en: That's really just to create some additional clustering towards the top.
cues.zh: 只是為了在頂端附近多製造一些資料聚集。

cues.en: Alright, so let's run this and let's see, we're going to, I'll even plot the raw data.
cues.zh: 好，執行看看。我甚至會把原始資料也畫出來。

cues.en: So let's say plot data.
cues.zh: 輸入 plot(data)。

cues.en: Let's make these plus signs.
cues.zh: 把標記設為加號。

cues.en: So this is the effect of that.
cues.zh: 這就是它造成的效果。

cues.en: This line of code here, thresholding.
cues.zh: 就是這行進行門檻處理的程式。

cues.en: You can see that there's a lot of data that are thresholded right around here.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，這附近有很多資料受到了門檻處理。

cues.en: The clustering is higher around five than it is between, you know, three and a half and just below five.
cues.zh: 5 附近的聚集程度，比 3.5 到略低於 5 的這個區間更高。

cues.en: So that's just gonna give us some additional interesting little bolus at the top of the violin plot.
cues.zh: 所以這會讓小提琴圖頂端多出一個有趣的小鼓包。

cues.en: Okay, so first, just don't worry about these lines, I'll get back to that in a moment.
cues.zh: 好，先別管這幾行，我等一下會回來說明。

cues.en: So remember in the video I said that to create a violin plot, you basically take a histogram, rotate it and flip it or mirror it, and then just draw that as a patch.
cues.zh: 記得我在影片中說過，建立小提琴圖基本上就是把直方圖旋轉，再翻轉或鏡射，最後用 patch 畫出來。

cues.en: So that's why we start here by getting the histogram, the distribution of the data based on the histogram.
cues.zh: 所以我們先在這裡取得直方圖，也就是用直方圖表示的資料分布。

cues.en: And here I'm using the Freedman-Diaconis Rule.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 Freedman–Diaconis 規則。

cues.en: Here, I'm normalizing the Y value so that they just go up to one.
cues.zh: 這裡將 Y 值正規化，讓最大值為 1。

cues.en: It's already plot this histogram.
cues.zh: 先把這個直方圖畫出來吧。

cues.en: I'm gonna plot X by Y.
cues.zh: 我要畫出 X 對 Y 的圖。

cues.en: So here you see the log normal distribution, it has a maximum value of one, and there's this little additional clustering up here.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到對數常態分布，最大值為 1，而且上方還有這一小群額外聚集的資料。

cues.en: This max value normalization here is just done for convenience because this profile here is going to go on the X axis.
cues.zh: 這裡用最大值進行正規化，只是為了方便，因為這個輪廓之後會放在 X 軸上。

cues.en: So normalizing them by one just makes it easier to specify the X axis.
cues.zh: 所以把最大值正規化成 1，會比較容易設定 X 軸。

cues.en: Remember, when we're creating a violin plot, we don't really care about the absolute numbers per se, we just care about the shape of the distribution.
cues.zh: 記住，建立小提琴圖時，我們並不太在意絕對數值本身，而是在意分布的形狀。

cues.en: That's the main point of a violin plot.
cues.zh: 這才是小提琴圖的重點。

cues.en: Okay, and here I'm computing inner quartile range.
cues.zh: 好，這裡計算四分位距。

cues.en: Now notice I'm not actually using the MATLAB function IQR, I'm computing this myself based on code that I showed you several videos ago about computing IQR.
cues.zh: 注意，我並沒有使用 MATLAB 的 iqr 函式，而是根據幾部影片前示範過的程式，自行計算四分位距。

cues.en: And you'll see why I do that in a moment.
cues.zh: 你等一下就會看到為什麼要這麼做。

cues.en: Okay, so let's see.
cues.zh: 好，我們看看。

cues.en: We're gonna walk through this violin plot here.
cues.zh: 接下來逐步檢視這個小提琴圖。

cues.en: First we start with the histogram of the data, again, just to see a little bit of the shape.
cues.zh: 首先從資料的直方圖開始，同樣只是為了稍微看一下形狀。

cues.en: And then what I do is create a patch.
cues.zh: 然後建立一個 patch。

cues.en: Let me first draw this patch.
cues.zh: 我先把這個 patch 畫出來。

cues.en: So the patch command in MATLAB is sometimes a little bit weird to interpret because you have like, you know, the X values, which are actually now the the Y values from the histogram.
cues.zh: MATLAB 的 patch 指令有時不太容易理解，因為這裡的 X 值，其實是剛才直方圖的 Y 值。

cues.en: But these are the X coordinates.
cues.zh: 不過，它們在這裡是 X 座標。

cues.en: They go forwards and then minus and backwards.
cues.zh: 先正向排列，然後取負號並反向排列。

cues.en: And these are the Y coordinates, which are the X values, and they go forwards and then backwards.
cues.zh: 這些則是 Y 座標，也就是原本的 X 值，先正向，再反向。

cues.en: This seems really weird, it's hard to wrap your head around how patch works at first.
cues.zh: 這看起來真的很奇怪，剛開始很難理解 patch 的運作方式。

cues.en: But the way to think about this is if you're drawing this polygon, then you know, imagine you start here and with your finger or with your mouse, you just draw around the edges like this.
cues.zh: 但你可以這樣想：如果要畫這個多邊形，就想像從這裡開始，用手指或滑鼠沿著邊緣繞一圈。

cues.en: So now notice I'm going up on the Y axis, but now we have to draw the right side of this polygon.
cues.zh: 注意，現在我沿著 Y 軸往上走，但接著必須畫出多邊形的右側。

cues.en: So I have to draw the Y axis again, except now I'm drawing the Y axis in reverse.
cues.zh: 因此要再畫一次 Y 軸，只是這次要反向畫。

cues.en: I'm drawing it down from the top.
cues.zh: 也就是從頂端往下畫。

cues.en: So that's basically, you know, that sort of helps explain why you need this thing.
cues.zh: 這樣應該能幫助你理解，為什麼需要這段設定。

cues.en: In fact, looking at this code now it looks like what we're doing is drawing it around this way.
cues.zh: 其實現在看這段程式，我們畫出的方向應該是這樣。

cues.en: So we start on the positive side and then we flip and we go negative and in reverse down here.
cues.zh: 先從正值側開始，接著翻轉到負值側，並反向往這裡畫下來。

cues.en: Okay, so that's basically the violin plot.
cues.zh: 好，這基本上就是小提琴圖了。

cues.en: Now I'm just gonna add a couple of extra lines to it to make it look a bit nicer.
cues.zh: 現在再加幾條線，讓它看起來更漂亮。

cues.en: So we got the IQR here in black.
cues.zh: 這裡以黑色表示 IQR。

cues.en: So the inner quartile range, we got the mean and the median.
cues.zh: 也就是四分位距，另外還有平均值和中位數。

cues.en: Or actually, sorry, this is the median, this is the mean.
cues.zh: 更正一下，這個是中位數，這個是平均值。

cues.en: And then I'm just going to make the axis look a little bit nicer and put a legend on there and the title.
cues.zh: 然後稍微美化座標軸，加上圖例和標題。

cues.en: And there we go.
cues.zh: 完成了。

cues.en: Here we see our violin plot.
cues.zh: 這裡就是我們的小提琴圖。

cues.en: Now you see it's like a little bit jagged.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，它有點鋸齒狀。

cues.en: There's all these kind of straight lines in here.
cues.zh: 裡面有這些一段一段的直線。

cues.en: So that's basically why I have this option here to up sample the data.
cues.zh: 這也就是為什麼我在這裡提供了上取樣資料的選項。

cues.en: So we see that right now there's only 18 points that are making up this line here.
cues.zh: 可以看到，目前只有 18 個點構成這條線。

cues.en: This profile is just 18 points.
cues.zh: 這個輪廓只有 18 個點。

cues.en: So what I'm doing here is interpolating the values of Y up to 100.
cues.zh: 所以這裡我把 Y 的數值內插成 100 個點。

cues.en: And let's see, we don't need to redo that.
cues.zh: 看看，我們不需要重做那個。

cues.en: I will, let's see, I'll put this in figure two.
cues.zh: 我把這個放到 figure 2。

cues.en: So then we can compare.
cues.zh: 這樣就可以比較。

cues.en: And I think I can just run this entire cell.
cues.zh: 我想直接執行整個儲存格就可以了。

cues.en: That should work.
cues.zh: 應該可行。

cues.en: Okay, so now going back and forth between figure one and figure two.
cues.zh: 好，現在在 figure 1 和 figure 2 之間切換。

cues.en: You can see we're not really changing anything fundamental about the plot.
cues.zh: 可以看到，我們沒有改變圖形的任何根本特性。

cues.en: We just interpolated, we up sampled it to make it look a little bit smoother.
cues.zh: 只是進行內插和上取樣，讓它看起來平滑一些。

cues.en: I think this looks a little bit nicer and I hope you agree.
cues.zh: 我覺得這樣比較好看，希望你也同意。

cues.en: All right, so here we are in Python, going to make these violin plots.
cues.zh: 好，現在來到 Python，繪製這些小提琴圖。

cues.en: So I start by creating the data here.
cues.zh: 首先在這裡建立資料。

cues.en: And the way that I create these data is by first generating a log normal distribution, which you've now seen several times already.
cues.zh: 建立資料的方式，是先產生對數常態分布，這個你已經看過好幾次了。

cues.en: And then I have one weird looking extra line of code that I don't typically use.
cues.zh: 接著有一行看起來有點奇怪、我平常不太使用的額外程式。

cues.en: So let's see what's going on here.
cues.zh: 我們來看看這裡在做什麼。

cues.en: So I define some threshold values, just a bit arbitrary.
cues.zh: 先定義一些門檻值，數值有點隨意。

cues.en: And then I'm saying that all of the data points that exceed that threshold value, I redefine them to be that threshold value plus some normally distributed random numbers,
cues.zh: 然後把所有超過門檻值的資料點，重新定義為門檻值加上一些常態分布隨機數，

cues.en: not log normally distributed, but just regular gaussian distributed numbers that are scaled down by a factor of 10.
cues.zh: 不是對數常態分布，而是一般高斯分布的隨機數，並縮小為十分之一。

cues.en: So essentially what this line of code is going to do is produce a large amount of clustering towards the top of the data.
cues.zh: 所以這行程式基本上會在資料頂端附近產生大量聚集。

cues.en: And let's see, I'm gonna, let's see what this looks like first.
cues.zh: 先來看看它的樣子。

cues.en: So I'm gonna write plt.plot data and let's make these plus signs.
cues.zh: 我輸入 plt.plot(data)，並把標記設為加號。

cues.en: So what you see here is the typical log normal distribution that you've seen before.
cues.zh: 這裡看到的就是之前看過的典型對數常態分布。

cues.en: But notice there's like a lot of clustering up here around five, much more clustering up here compared to, you know, this range here, like three to a little bit less than five.
cues.zh: 但注意，這裡約為 5 的地方有大量聚集，比起這一段，例如 3 到略低於 5 的區間，聚集得多得多。

cues.en: Now there's no particularly remarkable or important, meaningful reason why I did this.
cues.zh: 我這麼做沒有什麼特別了不起、重要或有意義的理由。

cues.en: I just think it's nice.
cues.zh: 只是覺得這樣不錯。

cues.en: It's going to add a little bit of an extra shape to the violin plot.
cues.zh: 這能讓小提琴圖多出一點額外的形狀變化。

cues.en: Okay, so now what I'm going to do is create a histogram and then a violin plot.
cues.zh: 好，現在我要建立直方圖，再建立小提琴圖。

cues.en: So Python is pretty easy to create a violin plot.
cues.zh: 在 Python 中繪製小提琴圖相當容易。

cues.en: You just use the function violinplot.
cues.zh: 只要使用 violinplot 函式。

cues.en: And there you go, you get the violin plot.
cues.zh: 這樣就得到小提琴圖了。

cues.en: So this shows the nice outline here.
cues.zh: 這裡呈現出漂亮的輪廓。

cues.en: And just as a reminder from the previous video, this line here is nothing more than this histogram here rotated and then mirrored on the other side.
cues.zh: 再提醒一下前一部影片的內容：這條線就只是把這個直方圖旋轉，再向另一側鏡射而已。

cues.en: So you see this little extra clustering of data here that corresponds to this.
cues.zh: 所以這裡額外聚集的這一小群資料，就對應這個位置。

cues.en: Now the violin plot of course looks smoother, but that's just because Python has up sampled and smoothed this histogram just to make it look a little bit nicer
cues.zh: 小提琴圖當然看起來比較平滑，但那只是因為 Python 對直方圖進行了上取樣和平滑化，讓它

cues.en: for this violin plot.
cues.zh: 在小提琴圖中看起來更漂亮。

cues.en: And then finally, I just wanna show you this other type of plot, which is pretty cool.
cues.zh: 最後，我還想展示另一種很酷的圖形。

cues.en: It comes in Seaborn and it's called a swarmplot.
cues.zh: 它來自 Seaborn，叫做 swarmplot，也就是蜂群圖。

cues.en: Sounds a little weird, but I think when you see this plot, you'll see why they call it a swarmplot.
cues.zh: 名字聽起來有點奇怪，但看到圖形後，你就會明白為什麼叫蜂群圖。

cues.en: So here is the swarmplot.
cues.zh: 這就是蜂群圖。

cues.en: It looks like a swarm of bees.
cues.zh: 看起來像一群蜜蜂。

cues.en: If you saw something like this in the sky coming directly at you, then I don't know what to do.
cues.zh: 如果你在天空中看到這樣的東西直衝著你來，我也不知道該怎麼辦。

cues.en: Run as fast as you can.
cues.zh: 能跑多快就跑多快吧。

cues.en: This is a a swarmplot.
cues.zh: 這就是蜂群圖。

cues.en: So it's a swarmplot is essentially like a violin plot, except that you see all of the individual data points as well.
cues.zh: 蜂群圖基本上很像小提琴圖，只是還能看見每一個個別資料點。

cues.en: So, depending on the distribution of your data, sometimes this swarmplot can be helpful.
cues.zh: 因此，視資料的分布而定，蜂群圖有時會很有幫助。

cues.en: Sometimes it looks pretty interesting, sometimes it's revealing and sometimes it's just a little bit annoying.
cues.zh: 有時看起來很有趣，有時能揭露資訊，有時則有點惱人。

cues.en: And you know, it's kind of like a lot of stuff to look at.
cues.zh: 因為要看的東西太多了。

cues.en: But I wanted to show it to you anyway, so you know that it's a possibility.
cues.zh: 不過我還是想介紹給你，讓你知道有這個選項。

cues.en: Now I have this optional input here for orient equals V.
cues.zh: 這裡有個選用輸入 orient='v'。

cues.en: You might have already guessed that this is for the orientation vertical.
cues.zh: 你可能已經猜到，這代表垂直方向。

cues.en: If I leave this out, the default orientation is horizontal.
cues.zh: 如果省略它，預設方向就是水平。

cues.en: So this looks a little bit more like a histogram actually, but it's mirrored.
cues.zh: 這樣看起來其實更像直方圖，只是有鏡射。

cues.en: So this is like a histogram on a quiet lake in late summer.
cues.zh: 就像夏末平靜湖面上的直方圖倒影。
